objective.name: sandbox.dsl.parallel.alias.reflective.mix
objective.description: Run local and remote reflective calls in parallel, then consume the merged aliases in one downstream wrapper call.

#root.role: Launch one local read.meaning, one remote meaning.query, and one remote read.state in parallel, then synthesize one final wrapper input from all merged aliases.

effects.parallel_reflective_reads: Local and remote reflective reads are executed concurrently.
effects.parallel_alias_merge: Aliases produced in parallel branches are merged for a downstream wrapper call.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one final wrapper input projection after multiple reflective branches execute concurrently and their aliases are merged coherently.
invariants: The remote meaning projection is rebuilt once before the parallel block so the remote query branch reads from a refreshed index.
The terminal wrapper call merges local_meaning, remote_query, and remote_state aliases without cross-branch contamination.
success: The terminal payload exposes received_params.label, received_params.local_name, received_params.remote_name, and received_params.remote_ctx.
received_params.local_name comes from the local read.meaning descriptor, while remote_name and remote_ctx come from the remote query and remote state branches.
failure: The flow fails if the remote rebuild or any reflective branch fails after its retry policy is exhausted.
The flow fails if the final wrapper call cannot consume the merged alias projection.
notes: This scenario validates alias merging after >parallel with mixed local and remote reflective branches.
The cached variant of this capacity removes the rebuild step to isolate concurrency behavior from projection rebuild races.
